items.raw_excerpt: Inklusives Sommerfest im Dorf St. Anton am 24. Juli mit Ponyreiten, Eselwanderungen, Live-Musik und Gesundheitsstraße. Besucher lobten die Atmosphäre.
items.summary_en: St. Anton am Arlberg hosted an inclusive summer festival on July 24 with pony rides, donkey walks, live music, and a health street. The village event welcomed visitors of all abilities and celebrated community togetherness. Guests praised the warm and joyful atmosphere throughout the day.

items.title_en: Village Summer Festival Brings Inclusive Fun to St. Anton

items.raw_excerpt: Thousands of Queen fans sang, cheered and partied at the Freddie Mercury statue in Montreux, Switzerland, on Saturday to celebrate what would have been the legendary British singer's 80th birthday.
items.summary_en: Thousands of fans gathered at the Freddie Mercury statue in Montreux to celebrate his 80th birthday. They sang and cheered at the lakeside memorial to honor the legendary Queen singer.

items.raw_excerpt: Are rumors of a move from CONCACAF to CONMEBOL for the men's national team true, and what it would mean for Mexican soccer?
items.summary_en: A report examines whether Mexico's men's soccer team could leave CONCACAF and join South America's CONMEBOL confederation. The move would change rivalries, tournament schedules, and the way Mexican clubs qualify for international competitions.

items.title_en: Could Mexico national team switch from CONCACAF to CONMEBOL?

items.raw_excerpt: The resurgence of wood furniture paired with earthy colour tones signals a shift toward softer, cosier interiors. By Sam Wylie-Harris.
items.summary_en: Wood furniture and earthy colour tones are making a comeback in home design. Designers say the trend points to a shift toward softer, cosier living spaces. Natural wood brings warmth and character to any room.

items.raw_excerpt: Romería a 53 años del golpe: Marcha hacia el Cementerio General activa desvíos de tránsito en Santiago
items.summary_en: A march to Santiago's General Cemetery marks 53 years since the 1973 coup in Chile. The procession has caused traffic diversions across parts of the city. Thousands of people walk the route each year to remember the victims.

items.title_en: 53rd Anniversary March to Cemetery Causes Traffic Detours in Santiago
